machine: AMD Ryzen 7 7700X (8 cores, 16 threads), Windows 11, preset msvc-release
notes: Gates for CTest bench.<suite> (bench/se_bench/CMakeLists.txt reads n, iterations, warmup and p95_ms). Thresholds hold for Release builds on this machine; other machines are pending gates (docs/gates.md).

renderlist_10k.source: M3 exit gate: RenderList of 10k sprites, p95 <= 1 ms in Release (docs/milestone-specs.md M3c)

measured.note: Ranges over 5 runs of 1000 warm iterations (7556 of 10000 sprites visible, 32 batches) while other builds shared the machine; the p99 and max outliers are that load.

render_frame_10k.source: M7 exit gate: RenderList plus sprite vertices of 10k visible sprites, CPU side, p95 <= 1 ms in Release (docs/milestone-specs.md M7, Bench)

measured.note: Idle machine (CPU load 5% before and after): the ctest run of bench.render_frame_10k in scripts/ci.ps1 -Presets msvc-release plus 5 runs of se_bench --suite render_frame_10k; renderlist_10k in the same minutes: median 0.375-0.402 ms, p95 0.418-0.453 ms. 10000 of 10000 sprites visible, 0 culled. Earlier the same day under other agents' parallel builds (CPU at 100%): median 0.699-0.777 ms, p95 0.868-2.054 ms.

lane_steps.source: M9 exit gate: the background lane's steps, a 1 MB read, a 256 KB LZ4 block decode and a 256-entity scene chunk parse, each p99 <= 2 ms in Release (docs/milestone-specs.md M9, Bench); bench/lane_steps

measured.note: se_lane_bench --iterations 1000 --warmup 50 with other agents' builds on the machine (CPU load 13%); the read is of a cached 64 MB file, the block of a 64-block page with its hash, the chunk validated by glaze and read by reflection (ADR-082). A chunk parsed into glaze's generic value measured median 1.16 ms, p99 1.81 ms (CPU load 32%). Rerun idle (docs/gates.md).

snapshot_publish_10k.source: M17a bench: one snapshot slot of 10k sprites filled and published, its p95 recorded as a threshold (docs/milestone-specs.md M17a, Bench): 2 x 0.140 ms, the median of five runs' p95, as for rampage_tick_5k

measured.note: se_bench --suite snapshot_publish_10k --iterations 1000 --warmup 50, CPU load 8-10% before and after: AppendRenderView of 10000 sprites (680000 bytes of RenderItems plus the sparse index) into one warm slot, its publish and its return. renderlist_10k in the same minutes (after its build moved to src/quad_builder.h, ADR-086): median 0.372-0.386 ms, p95 0.409-0.445 ms, as before.

rampage_tick_5k.source: The measured p95 with 2x headroom (docs/milestone-specs.md M3c): 2 x 3.109 ms, the median of five runs' p95; the design's tick budget is 1/160 s = 6.25 ms

measured.note: Ranges over 5 runs of 1000 ticks after 50 untimed ones (5000 movers and the player; deterministic: 4995 entities alive at the end, 18 contacts in the last tick). Per-system medians of one run: Cleanup (drain, FinalizeSpawns, world hash) 1.27 ms, Collision 0.91 ms, Path 0.33 ms, Boundary and PrevTransformCopy 0.03 ms each.

fork_empty_w1.source: M14 bench: one threaded fork of 8 empty chunks back to back (the workers spinning between forks) at W = 1; the limit is about four times the largest measured p95 (0.0006 ms)

measured.note: 9 runs of se_bench --suite fork_empty_w1 --n 8 --iterations 5000 --warmup 200 while other processes took 5-28% of the CPU (quiet, not idle; an idle rerun is a gate in docs/gates.md): participants 2, the site's join p99.9 1.4-1.6 us and max 3.6-12.2 us, the largest wake latency 252-302 us.
